campaign.name: Perfumarte AI Art Direction
campaign.objective: Generate two visually coherent premium campaign images for Alma Tropical (TOK), translating its luminous fruity-floral identity into a rich editorial still life and a dynamic immersive surreal scene.

visual_relationship.rule: Both images represent the same Alma Tropical (TOK) fragrance identity, olfactive story and emotional atmosphere through shared tropical luminosity, juicy fruit, exotic florals and clean white woods.
consistency: same coral, citrus, blush and white palette
same radiant, joyful and fresh emotional atmosphere

physical_scale_system.scale_reference: Use the perfume bottle as the physical scale reference for the entire scene.
physical_scale_system.element_scale_rule: Every surrounding ingredient and environmental object must have realistic physical proportions relative to the perfume bottle.
physical_scale_system.relative_scale: Every surrounding ingredient and environmental object must have realistic physical proportions relative to the perfume bottle.
physical_scale_system.artistic_scale_override: Do not create abundance by artificially enlarging ingredients.

fragrance_data.name: Alma Tropical (TOK)
fragrance_data.description:
Alma Tropical (TOK): un perfume afrutado floral lleno de luz y vitalidad

Alma Tropical (TOK) es un perfume afrutado floral para mujer que combina la frescura de las frutas jugosas con la delicadeza de las flores exóticas y un fondo suave de almizcle y maderas blancas. Una fragancia radiante, dulce y luminosa que transmite alegría, frescura y una sensación de bienestar desde la primera nota.

Su equilibrio entre acordes cítricos, frutas vibrantes y un corazón floral elegante la convierte en un perfume femenino, versátil y perfecto para quienes buscan un aroma alegre, fresco y lleno de personalidad.

¿A qué huele Alma Tropical (TOK)?

Alma Tropical (TOK) fusiona frutas, flores y notas suaves para crear una fragancia luminosa, dulce y muy envolvente.

Una salida fresca y afrutada

La bergamota, las frutas rojas, el limón, la pera y el sorbete crean una apertura chispeante y jugosa, con un carácter fresco y vibrante que despierta los sentidos desde el primer instante.

Un corazón floral y femenino

El jazmín sambac, el melocotón y la rosa forman un bouquet elegante y delicado, aportando feminidad, suavidad y un toque exótico que envuelve la fragancia con armonía.

Un fondo suave y luminoso

El almizcle blanco, las maderas blancas y el musgo crean una base limpia, cálida y sofisticada que deja una estela delicada, fresca y duradera sobre la piel.

olfactive_translation.principle: Translate Alma Tropical (TOK) into a visual story of radiant citrus freshness, juicy red fruit, exotic white floral femininity and a soft clean base, rather than literally representing every listed note.
selection_rules: Select only the most visually expressive olfactive elements.
Prioritize elements that communicate the fragrance identity.
Do not visually represent every note by default.
Atmospheric notes may be represented through color, texture, material, smoke, light or environment.
Never introduce ingredients that are not supported by fragrance_data.notes.
The selected visual elements must work coherently across both campaign images.

selected_visual_notes.olfactive_role: Citrus top note; luminous, fresh and sparkling opening.
selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: Several realistic bergamot fruits, some whole and some naturally cut, with textured yellow-green rind and translucent citrus flesh.
selected_visual_notes.reason: Communicates the radiant citrus freshness that defines the first impression of the fragrance.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: A principal foreground and midground cluster beside the bottle, with a few cut sections revealing juicy texture without touching or covering the bottle.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: A controlled group of whole and cut bergamots suspended at different depths, with a few tiny citrus droplets and a subtle swirling mist suggesting freshness.

selected_visual_notes.olfactive_role: Juicy fruity top note; vibrant, sweet and energetic.
selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: Natural clusters of small red berries in varied stages, including glossy whole berries and a few split berries with realistic juice.
selected_visual_notes.reason: Adds the vivid tropical-fruity energy and saturated color of the composition.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: Several low, natural berry clusters layered around the surface in the foreground and midground, never enlarged beyond realistic scale.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: A restrained stream of berries and a few detached droplets moving naturally through the air around the bottle, integrated with the atmospheric flow rather than arranged geometrically.

selected_visual_notes.olfactive_role: Bright citrus accent; crisp and refreshing.
selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: Small realistic lemons and thin lemon slices with vivid yellow peel, translucent pulp and subtle moisture.
selected_visual_notes.reason: Sharpens the feeling of clean, sparkling freshness and creates a high-key citrus color accent.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: Moderate supporting quantity placed toward the edge of the still-life surface and in the background, leaving generous negative space for Spanish typography.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: A few lemon slices and fine citrus particles suspended in the midground, following a gentle, physically plausible airflow.

selected_visual_notes.olfactive_role: Exotic white floral heart; feminine, delicate and luminous.
selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: Several small white jasmine sambac blossoms and natural green stems, with detailed petals and subtle shadows.
selected_visual_notes.reason: Provides the fragrance's floral identity and elegant feminine heart without introducing a generic oversized flower.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: The main floral grouping behind and beside the bottle, with multiple blossoms at realistic scale and some shallow-focus petals in the foreground.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: A suspended, gently drifting group of jasmine blossoms and slender stems around the bottle, with natural spacing and no artificial floral crown or geometric arrangement.

selected_visual_notes.olfactive_role: Soft fruity-floral heart; velvety, sweet and enveloping.
selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: Several realistic small peach sections and one or two whole peaches with velvety skin, warm blush and moist flesh.
selected_visual_notes.reason: Bridges the juicy opening and soft floral heart while bringing tactile warmth to the palette.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: Moderate cut-fruit presence in the foreground and midground, grouped naturally with berries but kept physically subordinate to the bottle.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: A few peach fragments and one whole peach placed at varied depths near a suspended atmospheric flow, with no implausible levitation of heavy pieces.

selected_visual_notes.olfactive_role: Clean soft base; enveloping, delicate and luminous.
selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: A translucent veil of soft white vapor, diffused pearly light and clean satin-like atmospheric texture rather than a literal ingredient.
selected_visual_notes.reason: Represents the abstract cleanliness and softness of white musk without inventing an unsupported physical object.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: A subtle pearly haze in the background and around the surface, preserving bottle clarity and creating a luminous clean finish.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: A controlled white atmospheric veil surrounding the spatial environment behind the bottle, with soft volumetric diffusion interacting naturally with the suspended ingredients.

shared_visual_identity.concept: Luz tropical suspendida: una celebración premium de cítricos jugosos, frutos rojos, jazmín blanco y suavidad limpia, construida como un oasis luminoso y femenino.
shared_visual_identity.emotional_goal: Transmitir alegría inmediata, bienestar, frescura vital y una feminidad tropical elegante, sin perder la sofisticación de la alta perfumería.
shared_visual_identity.environmental_identity: Un oasis botánico tropical contemporáneo, luminoso y limpio, con una atmósfera de estudio natural sofisticado, humedad fresca y materiales táctiles de alta gama.
visual_anchor_elements: agrupaciones realistas de bergamota y limón
reflejos de luz cálida y fresca

editorial_still_life.concept: Bodegón editorial de luz tropical sobre una superficie mineral marfil, donde la botella vertical y estable aparece rodeada por agrupaciones abundantes pero controladas de cítricos, frutos rojos, melocotón y jazmín sambac.

environment.description: Superficie horizontal de piedra caliza marfil ligeramente húmeda, con una pared de fondo cálida y luminosa que sugiere un oasis tropical abstracto mediante sombras suaves de hojas fuera de campo. La botella se apoya físicamente sobre la superficie, completamente vertical y estable.
environment.background_rule: El fondo debe permanecer limpio, luminoso y con textura sutil, dejando un área de espacio negativo generoso para la tipografía española sin competir con la botella.

flores blancas de jazmín sambac con tallos verdes

madera blanca discreta en el fondo

lighting.style: premium commercial photography with radiant tropical daylight

elements: Perfume afrutado floral lleno de luz y vitalidad
rules: Typography must never cover the perfume bottle.

Do not overload the image with text.

immersive_surreal.concept: Una corriente luminosa de frescura tropical atraviesa un oasis suspendido: la botella flota cerca del centro sobre el eje visual, inclinada de forma fija entre 5 y 12 grados con el tapón ligeramente desplazado hacia la izquierda y la base hacia la derecha, mientras cítricos, frutos rojos, pétalos y niebla perlada construyen profundidad física alrededor de ella.

environment.description: Entorno tridimensional compuesto por una base inferior de piedra mineral clara y vegetación desenfocada, un plano medio de frutas y jazmín alrededor de la botella, y un fondo profundo de luz coral-dorada, niebla blanca perlada y sombras botánicas. La botella permanece completamente visible, separada de los ingredientes y suspendida cerca del centro visual.

visual_elements: botella única de Alma Tropical (TOK), suspendida cerca del centro y con inclinación fija de 5–12 grados, tapón hacia la izquierda y base hacia la derecha
bergamotas enteras y cortadas en distintas distancias de cámara
grupos naturales de frutos rojos, algunos muy próximos al objetivo y parcialmente desenfocados
limones y finas rodajas con gotas realistas
jazmín sambac blanco con tallos y pétalos en movimiento suave
melocotones y fragmentos de melocotón en planos diferenciados
niebla blanca perlada y pequeñas partículas de humedad
piedra mineral y vegetación desenfocada en el plano inferior
